say:0:1120828001:0.text: Is that milk thistle there? There's a scary-looking terrabird right next to it!
say:0:1120828001:0.source_cn: 那是不是就是乳蓟？旁边还有一只看起来很凶恶的陆行鸟！

say:1:1120828002:0.text: Oh, right... Animals that have been bitten by something venomous usually go find milk thistles to cure themselves.
say:1:1120828002:0.source_cn: 啊……果然……那是被毒物咬伤过的动物，为了解毒来找乳蓟吃了。

say:2:1120828003:0.text: I've learned a lot from animals out here. Sorry about this, my feathered friend!
say:2:1120828003:0.source_cn: 我这些门道，不少是从这些野生动物身上偷学的。今天对不住...
